source_of_truth: Read by hand in app/components/forms/ProfilePanel.vue: both native controls have an accessible name even though neither has a <label for> or local text. (1) The email <input> (line 9) is nested inside a custom <FormField label="Email address"> component that owns the label; its name is rendered by the component. (2) The search <input> (line 12) carries aria-labelledby="filters-title" which points at the visible <h2 id="filters-title"> above it. A correct auditor reports NO defect here. Derived from the markup and ARIA relationships, not from the tool.

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: the email input (line 9) is encapsulated: its nearest custom-component ancestor <FormField> declares a label-like prop (label="Email address"), so the component provides the accessible name; flagging it would be a false positive
the search input (line 12) is named by aria-labelledby="filters-title", a valid accessible-name mechanism pointing at the visible heading id; flagging it would be a false positive
